name: Senzuri Nikki ～Genba Oyakata Yoshinori Sugou～
original_name: センズリ日記～現場親方・須郷義則～
source: Yoshinori Sugou, a 45-year-old construction worker. On the evening before his day off, after finishing up at the job site as usual, Sugou heads home while glancing at the workers heading out for drinks. This man, who is trusted as a reliable foreman, has a secret “plan”...
